intent: Dark product hero: headline, sub and CTAs above a markup-drawn mail app window that starts tilted back 22deg and flattens as it scrolls into place while a spotlight behind it brightens.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries, including a named @container/win)
stack.animation: motion/react: useScroll on the window frame, useSpring, useTransform

layout.stage: mt 56/80px; perspective 1200px wrapper with bottom mask (#000 52% -> transparent 96%)
layout.window: radius 14/18px; title bar 44px; body 440/520/600px; sidebar 212px (>= @4xl/win); list 340-372px (full width < @2xl/win); detail flex-1 (>= @2xl/win)

typography.app: rows 13/12.5/12px, detail body 13.5px leading 1.65, subject 19-21px semibold, mono 10-10.5px labels

color.accent: #f2c46d (eyebrow dot, Draft chips, draft label, progress bar only)

motion.scroll: useScroll target window frame, offset ['start end','start 20%']; rescaled by p0 = (vh - top)/(0.8 vh) so it starts fully tilted on load
motion.spring: stiffness 170, damping 32, mass 0.5; jump on first measure
motion.mapping: rotateX (1-p)*22deg, scale 0.94->1, y 24->0px, origin 50% 0%; spotlight opacity 0.22->1; top edge light 0.15->0.4->1
motion.entrance: eyebrow, headline (blur 8px), body and CTAs fade up 600-800ms with 80ms steps; window fades in over 900ms at 300ms
motion.reducedMotion: window flat, spotlight full, no blur, opacity-only fades

responsive.phone: CTAs stacked full width; window shows the list only

accessibility: window is a figure with role img and a descriptive aria-label; its contents are illustrative
CTAs are links with 2px white focus-visible ring offset 4px
reduced motion shows the window flat
no scroll hijacking: the page scrolls normally

content.headline: Your inbox, triaged before coffee.
content.body: Tern reads the overnight pile, sorts it into Reply, Read later and Ignored, and drafts the boring answers in your voice. You just press send.
content.app: 7 threads (Priya Raman: renewal 40 seats; Jonas Lindqvist: offer letter; Halcyon Capital: Q3 update; ...), open thread with a reply drafted by Tern

avoid: coloured traffic lights and rainbow avatars
glow or gradient borders around the window
tilting past flat or re-tilting jitter
